protectedRevelations: Later court verdicts and prescriptions beyond opening chapter

scenes.title: The prototype waits
scenes.viewerPurpose: Notice a founder stopping a pilot that people want Question how serious thought can hide from judgment
scenes.composition: A working imperfect prototype sits beside three trial invitations
addOrChange: Add a paused date without suggesting that trial use is dangerous.

cues.narration: The prototype works, three people want to try it, and the founder stops the pilot.
cues.visualAction: The founder pauses the trial despite the working prototype.

cues.narration: The Strategist’s Alibi investigates how serious thinking can become a refuge from judgment.
cues.visualAction: Hold invitations beside the bench as the book is named.

scenes.title: Preparation or escape
scenes.viewerPurpose: Recall the comfort of one more planning round Feel interested people slipping away while work waits
scenes.composition: Design revisions accumulate while a trial date passes
addOrChange: Replace rope and gorge with ordinary plans, calendar and withdrawn invitations.

cues.narration: There is always another foundation to revisit, another future risk to model.
cues.visualAction: The founder opens another foundational redesign.

cues.narration: Meanwhile, the people willing to care about the project may move on.
cues.visualAction: A waiting invitation expires while the prototype stays unused.

scenes.title: Someone pays for delay
scenes.viewerPurpose: Expect scenes and research that test those explanations Understand the book values planning enough to challenge it
scenes.composition: Collaborators examine a real unfinished task and its risks
addOrChange: Replace the well metaphor with prototype and a practical test checklist.

cues.narration: Through composite scenes and organizational research, the book questions the stories unfinished work tells about itself.
cues.visualAction: Compare the written reasons for delaying the same task.

cues.narration: The book takes careful planning seriously, which makes its challenge harder to brush aside.
cues.visualAction: Check one real risk without treating planning itself as pointless.

scenes.title: The unfinished room
scenes.viewerPurpose: See preparation becoming a substitute for beginning Ask whether protecting a future can prevent it
scenes.composition: One small prototype test remains possible
addOrChange: Add the remaining invitation and unstarted test card, without a launch outcome.

cues.narration: Anyone who builds things may recognize the comfort of preparing for work that never quite begins.
cues.visualAction: The founder arranges tools again and pauses before beginning.

cues.narration: When does protecting a future become the reason it never arrives?
cues.visualAction: Hold the reachable next test beside the elaborate plans.
